topic: The Mahjong Mirror's discipline applied to parenting a firehorse-year baby: reading the four pillars forward through the year, naming which months amplify the traits (the two wood months) and which one balances them (the Metal Dog window, Oct 8 - Nov 6), instead of guessing.
phrases: You can't pick the month. You can read it.
Year says how much engine. Month says how much emotion.
Don't label months good or bad. Read them.
Don't count your blessings. Ask why.

images.concept: A single desk calendar page turned to a future month, with one date circled in soft ink and a small unlit candle resting beside it, suggesting a known, awaited window of calm rather than an unknown future.
images.prompt: A cinematic close-up of an old-fashioned desk calendar page, softly lit, with one date circled in warm walnut ink. Beside it rests a small unlit taper candle in a simple brass holder. Warm antique gold light falls across the page from one side, fading to deep midnight jade shadow at the edges of the frame. The mood is anticipatory and calm, a known good day marked ahead of time rather than a surprise. No text is legible beyond the circle mark. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: Two young trees growing close together in a garden, both leaning toward the same patch of sunlight, roots visibly intertwined at the base, illustrating two wood months feeding one fire.
images.prompt: A warm photograph of two young saplings growing close together in a garden, both leaning toward the same patch of golden sunlight, their exposed roots visibly intertwined at the base in the soil. Soft sage green leaves, warm antique gold light streaming through the canopy above. The mood is quiet growth, two sources feeding the same warmth. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: TEXT-style card carrying the post's core mechanic as a punchy, quotable line.
images.text:
Year pillar: the engine.
Month pillar: the emotions.
images.prompt: A square social graphic, 1080x1080, deep midnight jade background with a soft antique gold gradient glowing gently from the top edge. Centered in elegant, confident modern serif typography, in warm antique gold, the phrase: "Year pillar: the engine. Month pillar: the emotions." Two lines, centered, generous letter spacing, the first line slightly larger than the second. A single thin gold hairline rule beneath the text. Minimal, atmospheric, no clutter. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: An overhead shot of a weather map style arrangement: small stones of varying warm tones placed along a curved line on dark fabric, marking a sequence of stages rather than a single point, suggesting a season mapped in advance.
images.prompt: An overhead photograph of a curved line of small smooth stones in varying warm tones (deep amber, dusty rose, pale gold, cool grey) laid out across dark textured fabric, evenly spaced like markers along a path. One stone near the end of the line is a distinct cool grey-blue, set slightly apart from the warm-toned ones before it. Soft directional light from one side. The composition reads like a sequence or timeline rendered in objects rather than any literal calendar or chart. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: Close-up of a compass resting on an aged map, needle steady, evoking navigation and foresight rather than guesswork.
images.prompt: A close-up cinematic photograph of an antique brass compass resting on an aged parchment-colored map, its needle steady and pointed. Warm antique gold light falls across the brass, catching small reflections. The map beneath is softly out of focus, its markings illegible. Deep midnight jade shadow at the frame's edges. The mood is quiet confidence, foresight rather than guesswork. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A quiet infant lying still and watchful in a crib, eyes open and alert rather than sleeping, lit softly from a window, visualizing the 'stillness is not the natural state, so pay attention' warning without any sense of danger.
images.prompt: A soft cinematic photograph of an infant lying in a crib, eyes open and alert, gazing toward a nearby window rather than the camera. Warm morning light filters through a sheer curtain, casting gentle patterns across the room. The mood is calm but watchful, a quiet moment worth noticing rather than one to worry over. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: An empty chair at a meeting table, softly lit, with a single warm light left on above it, suggesting the absence of an expected signal being worth noticing.
images.prompt: A quiet, cinematic photograph of a single empty chair at a long wooden table, softly lit by a warm overhead light left on above it while the rest of the room fades into deep midnight jade shadow. The mood is observant and thoughtful, an absence worth noticing rather than an empty room. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: Close-up of an hourglass with sand nearly settled and still, a single grain caught mid-fall, evoking the discipline of watching closely rather than assuming calm.
images.prompt: A macro cinematic photograph of an antique brass-framed hourglass, most of the sand settled and still in the bottom chamber, with a single grain of sand caught mid-fall in a shaft of warm antique gold light. Deep midnight jade background, soft focus. The mood is patient attentiveness, noticing the one thing still moving. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.
